title: Binary constant weight codes A(n,d,w)
keeper: A. E. Brouwer, bounds for binary constant weight codes (aeb.win.tue.nl/codes/Andw.html)
revision: Andw.html read 9 Nov 2026 04:27 UTC (last modified 5 Nov 2026 22:34 GMT)

template.title: Constant weight code A({n},{d},{w})
template.statement: Find binary words of length {n}, each with exactly {w} ones and any two differing in at least {d} positions, as many as possible: a lower bound on A({n},{d},{w}).
template.submission: Text file: one word per line, the {w} positions of its ones, distinct integers from 1..{n} separated by spaces.

score: the number of code words (more is better)
best_text: The best known lower bound in Andries Brouwer's table is {best} ({holder}); a code with more words improves it.
bound_source: the upper bound in the same table, when it gives one
holder_unknown: the table gives no label for this entry
holder_sources: the entry's label, read with the table's own key (sections Constructions and References for labels)
open_rule: every entry not marked optimal whose lower bound is below its upper bound (or has none)
left_out: 203 entries marked optimal or with equal bounds
